issues.detail: The skill contains verbose explanatory text that may distract from actionable steps.

scenarios.name: provision-fleet-with-reusable-auth-key
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required reusable key creation with both tags and a loop using the same key, though the expiry is incorrect; Response B omits one tag, uses a different expiry, and the loop command does not match the rubric exactly.

scenarios.name: setup-subnet-router-with-route-approval
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes all required commands and steps, while Response B omits key details such as the exact API endpoint, CIDR list, and client accept-routes command.

scenarios.name: enable-tailscale-ssh-with-acl
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets most rubric items but not the exact SSH command or user, while Response A fails to provide the required command, ACL snippet, and SSH command.
